title: Keller v. Holderman — a shared joke
shortTitle: Keller v. Holderman — a shared joke
summary: The watch-and-check example involves a transaction understood as a frolic by both parties.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

That shared understanding distinguishes it from Zehmer’s undisclosed claim to be joking where Lucy took the sale seriously and reasonably. The contrast explains why actual knowledge can matter within an objective analysis.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 176–177. Open assigned page 176.
